title: How does NovaTel use my call and location data?
content:
Question: How does NovaTel use my call and location data?

Answer: Data is processed per our Privacy Policy (see Policy_C19_privacy_policy) strictly for service delivery, billing, legal/regulatory compliance, network optimisation, and — where you have consented — personalised offers. You can review and manage consent preferences under Privacy Settings in the app.

Topic: Privacy & Data Protection
